title: Thread race and blocking rules
summary: Four lint rules: racing writes in parallel bodies, non-atomic global increments in threads, unbounded waits in forms, lost task exceptions
intro: Read this when you want lint to catch data races between threads, a frozen window, or an exception lost inside a TTask. Run `drag-lint lint <unit.pas>` or `lint-all`; each rule is selectable with --rule. With an index the rules also recognise thread, form and frame classes whose ancestor lives in another unit.
